trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(dp:Document), (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(dt:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) WHERE (c.city_name <> 'Los Angeles' OR CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) < 1967) RETURN CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) AS col1, CAST(t.championships AS INT64) AS col2, CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) AS col3, t.team_name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
